experiment_design.control: Same professors, same query, same model — only embedding content changes
confounds_fixed: Population restricted to same 296 professors in both conditions

hypothesis_1_jargon_dilution.caveat: n_relevant_tested=3 is a SMALL sample -- only 3 of the corpus's relevant professors happened to fall within the pre-selected 'biggest_score_changes' list (top-20 by magnitude among 79 professors with arXiv papers). This result should be treated as suggestive, not confirmatory. A systematic test across all relevant professors (not just the largest-change subset) is needed before treating H1 as established.

hypothesis_2_recency_bias.interpretation: 73%+ papers from 2025-2026; may not reflect primary expertise
